fusions.name: Unheard Pounce
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and strikes with your weapon for 14 damage, making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Batting Claws
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Rakes a cone 2.5 tiles ahead of you for 8 damage.

fusions.name: Hushed Wings
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: One of Many
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
